correctness.rationale: A left ideal I of T_n(F_q) splits by the diagonal idempotents into row subspaces U_i⊂span(e_i,...,e_n). Closure under each e_ij forces U_j⊂U_i for i<j, and conversely nested row flags define a left ideal. Given the dimension vector (d1≥...≥dn), choices for U_i/U_(i+1) are Gaussian binomials [n−i+1−d_(i+1) choose d_i−d_(i+1)]_q; total dimension is sum d_i. Each stratum is an iterated relative Grassmannian with dimension sum (d_i−d_(i+1))(n−i+1−d_i), and q=0 formally counts bounded monotone dimension sequences/Catalan C_(n+1). Independent Gaussian-binomial recurrence reproduced totals (n,q)=(2,2):7,(2,3):8,(3,2):40,(3,3):62,(4,2):362, and (3,2) coefficient array 1,7,10,11,7,3,1. These finite tests support but do not replace the all-n flag bijection.
